ev.q: Twenty (18%) of the 110 had chronic HCV infection at admission.

Ninety (82%) were anti-HCV negative at admission, of whom nine (10%) were determined to have acquired incident HCV infection
Among the 162 patients, a total of 45 (28%) had at least one anti-HCV positive EIA test result
